brief_title: Efﬁcacy and Safety of Weight-Based Insulin Titration Regimen in Hospitalized Patients With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: Efﬁcacy and Safety of Weight-Based Insulin Titration (WEB-IT) Regimen Compared With Glucose Level-based Regimen in Hospitalized Patients With Type 2 Diabetes: A Randomized Controlled Study

lead_sponsor.name: Second Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University

primary_outcomes.time_frame: at discharge, an average of 9 days
at discharge, an average of 9 days

brief_summary: The investigators propose to use a weight-based regimen consisting of basal-bolus insulin and preprandial rapid-acting insulin and to test its efficacy and safety in controlling blood glucose in hospitalized patients with type 2 diabetes.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients aged 18 to 80 years with type 2 diabetes admitted to Endocrinology wards.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with hepatic or renal dysfunction, cancer, or diabetic ketoacidosis;
* Patients who are pregnant or lactating.
